title: Annual Vet Spend vs Premium Paid
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=vet:invoice invoice_usd=*) OR (index=personal sourcetype=petinsurance:premium premium_usd=*)
| bin _time span=1y
| stats sum(invoice_usd) as vet_spend, sum(premium_usd) as premiums by _time pet_name
| eval net_cost=round(vet_spend-premiums,2), value_ratio=round(vet_spend/nullif(premiums,0),2)
| sort - value_ratio
description: Compares annual veterinary invoice totals against pet insurance premiums paid for each pet.
value: Premium-versus-spend ratio shows whether coverage is paying for itself or mostly funding peace of mind.
implementation: Align yearly vet invoices and premium payments by `pet_name` and review before renewal.
visualization: Bar chart of vet spend, premiums, and net cost by pet.
grandmaExplanation: It watches whether your pet insurance premiums are worth it compared with what you spent at the vet.
